text:
Maya: okay tiny game — drop the first line of a book that stuck with you and a 3-song mini-playlist you’d listen to while rereading it. no pressure, just vibes. I’ll go first.

Maya: "It is a truth universally acknowledged..." — Jane Austen, *Pride and Prejudice*. playlist: 1) 'Moon River' — Henry Mancini 2) 'Claire de Lune' — Debussy 3) 'Something in the Way' — Nirvana (gentle, rainy tea energy) :tea: :books:

Jorge: love this. mine: "The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel." — William Gibson, *Neuromancer*. playlist: 1) 'Blade Runner Blues' — Vangelis 2) 'Low Life' — Future Islands 3) 'Night Drive' — Chromatics. late-night neon coding feels :neon_sign:

Erin: ooh neat. mine is short: "All this happened, more or less." — Kurt Vonnegut, *Slaughterhouse-Five*. playlist: 1) 'I Want You' — Bob Dylan 2) 'Heroes' — David Bowie 3) 'Atmosphere' — Joy Division. slow, ironic, a little broken :slightly_smiling_face:

Samir: contribution: "When I was little I would sometimes lie awake at night and listen for the sound of the sea." — Joan Didion, *The Year of Magical Thinking* (not actually the first line but it hits). playlist: 1) 'The Sea' — Morcheeba 2) 'Holocene' — Bon Iver 3) 'Porcelain' — Moby. good for rainy windows and thinking about memory :ocean:

Erin: @Samir that choice is hitting hard rn.

Jorge: quick meta note — if anyone wants I can throw these into a collaborative Spotify playlist. ping me and I’ll add.

Maya: please do! tag me when it’s live. would love to listen on the walk home.

Dev Bot: [automated note] Reaction summary: Maya :heart: (4), Jorge :thumbsup: (3), Erin :sparkles: (2), Samir :cry: (1).

Samir: also curious — favorite opening line you wish you’d written?

Maya: "It was a pleasure to burn." — Ray Bradbury. simple and perfect. :fire:

Jorge: vote with emoji! add :thumbsup: to your fave opening-line/playlist combo and I’ll make the top 3 first.

Erin: :thumbsup: for Vonnegut + Joy Division (already queued it up in my head)

Samir: :thumbsup: for Didion + Bon Iver

Maya: :thumbsup: for Austen (guilty classic love)

Maya: thanks y’all, this was fun — low-key perfect breakup/commute therapy.

Jorge: thread for the walk home playlist next week? maybe "cookout reads + summer mixtape" :sunglasses:
